sourceCredits.en:
[Gameplay recordings]
Left 4 Dead — GamerSky
Left 4 Dead | Death Toll: The Church (Walkthrough) (No Commentary)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5madtYynQJA
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCN4SvJM-rLsbPRgokn5T_ew
Creative Commons Attribution 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Excerpted, reframed for vertical video, annotated and combined with independently written commentary.
Valve video policy: https://store.steampowered.com/video_policy?l=english

Project Zomboid — Survival Gamer
Project Zomboid | No Commentary | No Copyright Gameplay | Free To Use Gameplay
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nkq7tjnlmg4
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCiLVbsOBcH8URtmRxcX6cqQ
Used and edited under the uploader's description permission allowing use, editing and monetization with channel credit. This permission is not presented as a formal CC BY license.
Game video terms: https://projectzomboid.com/blog/support/terms-conditions/
The recording shows a quiet neighborhood in Build 42.5.0. It does not expose Director state or establish a recorded meta-gunshot event or zombie relocation. Sound-to-group movement is shown separately as an explanatory diagram.

[Technical references]
Michael Booth / Valve — The AI Systems of Left 4 Dead (2009), PDF pages 78–82 and 92
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/apps/valve/2009/ai_systems_of_l4d_mike_booth.pdf
The Indie Stone — Official Sandbox UI: Meta Event / Follow Sound Distance
https://github.com/TheIndieStone/ProjectZomboidTranslations/blob/master/EN/Sandbox_EN.txt
The Indie Stone — Developments on Lucky 7 (historical 2013 meta-event and group-movement design)
https://projectzomboid.com/blog/news/2013/05/developments-on-lucky-7/
The Indie Stone — AmbientStreamManager API
https://www.projectzomboid.com/modding/zombie/AmbientStreamManager.html
These references are not used to establish current Build 42 respawn defaults, exact event timing or every configuration.

[Music]
Music: Nimbus — Eveningland (YouTube Audio Library)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZOc84gXN-lg
https://www.youtube.com/audiolibrary
Music excerpted, gain-adjusted, ducked and faded.

[Production]
Original Yamyam Coding cat reaction artwork and explanatory diagrams.
Motion Canvas: https://motioncanvas.io/
Qwen3-TTS: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS
FFmpeg: https://ffmpeg.org/
The opening zombie/player animation is original vector artwork created by Yamyam Coding in Motion Canvas.
